editorial.blurb: Ajwaah Sweets is a beloved spot where expert staff and authentic South Asian treats—from masala tea to halwa puri—keep customers driving back again and again.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Masala Tea and Halwa Puri combo for breakfast, and ask Basith or Zeeshan for their recommendations on sweets; the fresh samosas and mango lassi are also standouts worth trying.
